flushEnabled.title: Flush enabled
flushEnabled.description: Indicates whether the flush operation (truncating all data in the bucket) is enabled

ramQuotaMB.title: RAM quota
ramQuotaMB.description: The amount of memory (RAM) to be allocated to the bucket per-node in megabytes (MB)

numReplicas.title: Number of replicas
numReplicas.description: The number of replicas that should exist for the bucket

replicaIndexes.title: Replica indexes
replicaIndexes.description: Indicates whether the indexes on the bucket should be replicated

bucketType.title: Bucket type
bucketType.description: The type of bucket that should be used

storageBackend.title: Storage backend
storageBackend.description: The storage backend to be used for the bucket

evictionPolicy.title: Eviction policy
evictionPolicy.description: The ejection method that should be used

maxExpiry.title: Max expiry
maxExpiry.description: The maximum expiry time that should be allowed for any document

compressionMode.title: Compression mode
compressionMode.description: The compression mode that should be used

minimumDurabilityLevel.title: Minimum durability level
minimumDurabilityLevel.description: The minimum durability level that should be used for any write operations that are performed against the bucket
